doc.title: Dan Wall and Adam Nussbaum interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001

title: Meeting heroes as people
summary: Nussbaum reflects that some admired musicians are like their music and others are not.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: just made me feel so good. And it was a great thing. And I guess that was one of those experiences that was kind of defining. Although I would never have known it at the time. Years later I said man, and he was like okay. It’s a great thing.
I can see that, watching his face and like woah.

But you remember these things as time goes on, and the people that you admire and then you get to meet them as people and some of them are fantastic human beings and they are kind of like the way the music is, and other people it’s another world the way they are. And that’s all part of it too. Where maybe their real self comes through the music.
